contracts: each release gate is bound to its exact canonical evidence filename
a similarly numbered lexicographically later JSON file cannot shadow canonical gate evidence
missing canonical gate evidence cannot be substituted by a differently named same-number file
multiple same-number evidence JSON files fail closed as ambiguous
closure evidence records the canonical evidence binding reason and relative path for accepted gates
known_limits: does not attest built release artifacts
real browser, microphone, storage, Android-device and iPhone-device release gates remain authoritative
